name: sg-semicon-expansion-plugin
description: Step-by-step US prospecting for Singapore semiconductor SMEs using three review-gated skills.

interface.shortDescription: Start here for step-by-step US prospecting.
interface.longDescription: Start with $map-sme-capability. It explains the three-step workflow, creates the first capability profile, and tells you exactly what to review before moving on. After that, use the copy-paste prompts it provides to discover possible US prospects and then qualify the strongest ones.
defaultPrompt: Use $map-sme-capability to start US expansion research. Ask me for the SME website or company profile if needed.
